name: Agnes Supportive Housing

heroImage.alt: NSC excavator loading a dump truck during street-front excavation on Agnes Street

lede: Earthworks and site services for a supportive housing building in New Westminster.
body:
We are carrying the excavation and site servicing for the new building, working for Keller Construction as prime contractor.

The work runs from street-front and bulk excavation for the building footprint to the underground services: precast manholes set inside trench shoring, PVC service connections, and a ductile iron water main with restrained joints and a new fire hydrant.
